name: Thunderclap
notes:
Proposed numbers: the burst hits every enemy within 70 (the orb's zap range), for 150% of one zap.

In game (hwp_wiz_tt_thunderclap, built): when the orb expires every enemy within its zap range takes 150% of a zap. Seen only as the orb's damage.
summary: When Tempest Orb expires, it bursts, dealing Lightning damage to all nearby enemies.
